diff --git a/src/click/none_incomplete_argument.py b/src/click/none_incomplete_argument.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..bbab4dc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/none_incomplete_argument.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Argument
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Parameter
+from .core import ParameterSource
+
+
+def none_incomplete_argument(ctx: Context, param: Parameter) -> bool:
+    """Determine if the given parameter is an argument that can still
+    accept values, treating a resolved value of ``None`` as incomplete.
+
+    This behaves like :func:`click.shell_completion._is_incomplete_argument`,
+    except that an argument whose value resolved to ``None`` is considered
+    incomplete even if its source is the command line. This is useful
+    for interactive forms that require a nonempty value.
+
+    :param ctx: Invocation context for the command represented by the
+        parsed complete args.
+    :param param: Argument object being checked.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(param, Argument):
+        return False
+
+    assert param.name is not None
+    # Will be None if expose_value is False.
+    value = ctx.params.get(param.name)
+    return (
+        param.nargs == -1
+        or ctx.get_parameter_source(param.name) is not ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE
+        or value is None
+        or (
+            param.nargs > 1
+            and isinstance(value, (tuple, list))
+            and len(value) < param.nargs
+        )
+    )
diff --git a/tests/test_none_incomplete_argument.py b/tests/test_none_incomplete_argument.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6d8ca3c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_none_incomplete_argument.py
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import click
+from click.core import ParameterSource
+from click.none_incomplete_argument import none_incomplete_argument
+from click.shell_completion import _is_incomplete_argument
+
+
+def _ctx(*params, args=()):
+    cmd = click.Command("cli", params=list(params))
+    return cmd.make_context("cli", list(args), resilient_parsing=True)
+
+
+def test_option_is_not_incomplete():
+    opt = click.Option(["--name"])
+    ctx = _ctx(opt)
+    assert not none_incomplete_argument(ctx, opt)
+
+
+def test_commandline_value_is_complete():
+    arg = click.Argument(["name"])
+    ctx = _ctx(arg, args=["x"])
+    assert not none_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+    assert not _is_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+
+
+def test_missing_value_is_incomplete():
+    arg = click.Argument(["name"])
+    ctx = _ctx(arg)
+    assert none_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+
+
+def test_commandline_none_value_is_incomplete():
+    arg = click.Argument(["name"])
+    ctx = _ctx(arg, args=["x"])
+    ctx.params["name"] = None
+    assert ctx.get_parameter_source("name") is ParameterSource.COMMANDLINE
+    assert none_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+    assert not _is_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+
+
+def test_empty_string_matches_existing():
+    arg = click.Argument(["name"])
+    ctx = _ctx(arg, args=[""])
+    assert none_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg) == _is_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+
+
+def test_nargs():
+    arg = click.Argument(["a"], nargs=2)
+    ctx = _ctx(arg, args=["x", "y"])
+    assert not none_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+    ctx.params["a"] = ("x",)
+    assert none_incomplete_argument(ctx, arg)
+    var = click.Argument(["b"], nargs=-1)
+    assert none_incomplete_argument(_ctx(var, args=["x"]), var)
notes:
Copied _is_incomplete_argument into a new module and added a value-is-None check so None resolves as incomplete even from COMMANDLINE; original untouched, tests added.
